name: Clark, Filer & Co.

partners.name: Filer
partners.basis: The firm's own style prints this partner's surname (Clark, Filer & Co.); no notice prints him apart from the house. Linked to the town card filer_a at inferred (T-2245): A. Filer & Co. advertise a cabinet and chair manufactory on South Water Street, printed 1834-03-04 to 1834-05-21; Clark, Filer & Co. advertise chairs at 'the cabinet shop of Clark, Filer & Co.' on South Water Street from 1834-05-28 (chicago_democrat_1834_05_28#c007, copy dated May 20, 1834). Same trade, same street, and the second style's printing opens the week the first's closes. The town holds two Filers: A. Filer (filer_a), the man the first style names, and Elihu D. Filer (filer_elihu_d), a letter-list name with no trade. The cabinet maker is A. Filer. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: The paper names a street and no house on it.
locations.limit_reason: The paper names South Water Street and nothing narrower; the anchor is a reach of randolph and names nothing narrower.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1834-05-28, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: The 1 keeper(s) this record names and the resident layer holds a card for all read yankee: Filer (yankee). A house is not its keeper, so the reading is an inference about the house and is capped there.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
